change: Native ARC player graves; no new cash rewards or currency conversion
baseline: Live Survival graves.yml SHA-256 d799ad7b260ef12a8cbbf4e615363d67e356419e45ca27f4a876cac008597c5e; GravesX defaults inspected

vault.note: Scenario event counts, not measured income. Independent successful visits pay again; duplicate confirmations do not.

experience.formula: floor(actual pre-death level/progress points * 0.8), never above pre-death points
experience.keep_level_policy: No XP escrow if another native policy keeps experience

items.flow: death drops -> durable grave -> owner inventory; overflow stays in grave
items.failure: Keep actual items/XP when placement/storage/capacity cannot admit safely. GravesX already enables placement.failure-keep-inventory; exact old XP/capacity fallback is not established.
items.scope_change: Owner-only native graves. Legacy Survival open-other/protection theft behavior and mob graves are not ported.
items.indirect_effect: More reliable recovery can reduce destroyed/lost/resold items; no player-rate measurement or fabricated Vault conversion is claimed.

bounds.sell_to_contract_plan: Active SELL and future SELL-to-contract transition unchanged; not counted as simultaneous new income.
bounds.multiaccount: Retrieves each owner's saved entitlement without new reward items/XP/money.

conclusion: Cash rates and XP fraction stay fixed; intended change is reliable escrow/recovery and owner privacy. Live usage and indirect item retention need observation after activation.
